_doc: Halal status of chain restaurants, by brand (Wikidata id, as tagged brand:wikidata on OpenStreetMap) and country. scope all: every branch in that country is halal according to the brand or its certifier. scope list: only the branches listed in ids (OpenStreetMap ids, matched one by one to the published list). scope some: only some branches are halal and no usable list exists; branches are shown apart, to be confirmed by members. Every rule carries its source. Never add a rule without one.
